name: jessi-ka
profile:
**Jessi-ka** is N-O-N's red-maned, wealthy, rule-breaking earth-pony school bully from the independent fan comic *A jessi-ka story*. Her father's protection lets her get away with misconduct; she targets a student who overtakes her academically.

**Look:** Charcoal-blue coat; enormous crimson mane and tail; often a white shirt, red tartan school uniform, tie, socks, and black shoes. Her smirk is as recognizable as her hair.

**Name and continuity:** “Jessi-ka” is the creator-used spelling (not a Hasbro character name). She belongs to N-O-N's fan-created story, not the *Friendship Is Magic* television continuity. No separate alter ego is verified.

**Story and credits:** Set at Rosay Rainer school, where unicorns and earth ponies study together. N-O-N is credited for story, supervision, and edits; Amelyne Gauthier for drawings and colors; Hebishiro for additional art. **Speech:** She speaks in comic dialogue, but no official animated appearance or credited voice actor was verified.

**Artwork** (both by **N-O-N**; uploaded to Twibooru by **anonymous mirroring accounts**, not attributed to those uploaders as artists):

[![Jessi-ka boasting in uniform — art by N-O-N](https://cdn.twibooru.org/img/2021/4/20/2384665/medium.png)](https://www.twibooru.org/2384665)

[![Jessi-ka with Kate and Lucy — art by N-O-N](https://cdn.twibooru.org/img/2026/5/27/3780839/medium.png)](https://twibooru.org/3780839)

**Creator and comic sources:** [N-O-N's own 2023 Jessi-ka OC portrait](https://www.deviantart.com/n-o-n/art/Sassy-Horse-Oc%3A-Jessi-ka-957944709) · [*A jessi-ka story* synopsis and production credits](https://www.canterlotcomics.com/comic/en/a_jessi-ka_story-1971).
